extra.message: Hardcoded fallback Django SECRET_KEY — Forgery of signed cookies/sessions/password-reset tokens if default key is used [verified: settings.py line 6 falls back to the publicly-known hardcoded SECRET_KEY 'dev-only-change-me' when DJANGO_SECRET_KEY is unset, enabling forgery of signed sessions and password-reset tokens; the insecure default is genuinely present and reachable.]

Hardcoded default Django SECRET_KEY — Forgeable session cookies, CSRF tokens, and password-reset tokens; potential auth bypass. [verified: Same line 6 hardcoded fallback SECRET_KEY 'dev-only-change-me' makes session cookies, CSRF tokens, and password-reset tokens forgeable in any deployment that omits the env var; duplicate of finding 1 but independently confirmed.]

Hardcoded default password for invited users — Anyone knowing the demo password can log in as any invited customer contact [verified: contact_invite sets every invited customer user's password to the hardcoded 'DemoPass123!' and even echoes it in a success message, so anyone knowing an invited contact's email can log in and reach that org's customer data.]

DEBUG enabled by default — Exposes stack traces, settings and source paths to attackers in default config [verified: settings.py line 7 defaults DEBUG to True when DJANGO_DEBUG is unset, so a default deployment serves Django debug pages leaking tracebacks, settings, and SQL; this is a genuinely present insecure setting on the reachable default path.]

CSV formula injection in exports — Formula execution / command execution in the victim's spreadsheet client [verified: export_csv writes user-influenceable values (esc.title settable by a customer contact, org/deal names) directly via csv.writer with no neutralization of leading =,+,-,@, so a crafted title like '=cmd|...' executes when the exported CSV is opened in a spreadsheet.]

CSV/formula injection in CSV exports — Arbitrary spreadsheet formula execution on the machine of whoever opens the exported CSV; can exfiltrate data or run commands via DDE. [verified: Same confirmed CSV-injection sink as idx 0 (export_csv csv.writer at the escalations branch writing esc.title/org.name unsanitized); a customer-created escalation title beginning with =,+,-,@ executes as a formula when staff open the export.]
